influences.name: Keith Jarrett
influences.context: From the age of 12, I would fall asleep listening to Keith Jarrett's solo piano albums, including 'The Köln Concert' and 'La Scala'.

influences.name: Chopin
influences.context: After having studied the Romantics (and Chopin's rubato), I was captivated by impressionist music

influences.name: Vangelis
influences.context: I think the first film score that dazzled me is 'Blade Runner' by Vangelis

influences.name: Hans Zimmer
influences.context: after listening to a lot of horror film scores, I heard the music of the feature film 'The Thin Red Line' by Hans Zimmer, which remains one of my favorites

influences.name: Philip Glass
influences.context: I constantly listen to Philip Glass, Hania Rani, Max Richter, and more generally, all those who emerge in this musical vein.
